justification.request_count: Sixteen is the measured auth-aware production navigation count, including the session check and sign-in prefetch; further requests require an explicit budget update.

static_shell_bytes.policy: 1,344 KiB is the smallest 64 KiB-rounded strict limit above the source-reviewed 1,347,449-byte assistant presentation export, measured 176,954 bytes above the exact cached production image baseline. It leaves 28,807 bytes of headroom and remains below the 1,408 KiB upper ceiling. Request, response, render, and interaction budgets are unchanged; this static bound is not performance acceptance.

justification.response_bytes: 640 KiB covers the measured 574,712 initial-navigation response-body bytes without compression assumptions.
justification.designated_response: The readiness response is the designated sub-8 KiB response.
